deferredDependentItems.exactQuestion: Do the newly accumulated Scout/Beta assist facts create an independently material contradiction requiring Resolver judgment before Alpha completes source-integrity and company-underwriting?
deferredDependentItems.whyItMatters: Resolver must not duplicate Alpha or reopen an already adjudicated contradiction merely because fresh root-owner evidence exists.
lawfulFallbacks: Council Alpha consumes the new primary-source facts into source-integrity, factor/risk/confidence evidence and numeric underwriting.
Deep Resolver reopens only if Alpha-complete evidence presents a materially incompatible claim or Chief explicitly adjudicates the dormant contradiction.
deferredDependentItems.successCondition: Alpha closes source-integrity/company-underwriting or produces a materially new contradiction with a changed input signature; otherwise the prior Resolver disposition remains dormant.
deferredDependentItems.reason: Dependent on concrete Council Alpha root-owner work. Current packet still lacks source-integrity and company-underwriting; fresh Scout evidence is explicitly recommended to Alpha and does not independently require Resolver judgment.
